rpgprogression.attribute.strength.toolti: Increases melee weapon damage. Does not change the item itself.
rpgprogression.attribute.endurance.toolt: Increases maximum stamina and unlocks main inventory slots in order.
rpgprogression.attribute.agility.tooltip: Increases movement speed and accelerates bow draw and crossbow charging. Diminishing returns prevent instant shots.
rpgprogression.attribute.vitality.toolti: Increases maximum health and resistance to physical damage and poisoning.
rpgprogression.attribute.intelligence.to: Unlocks crafting recipes and improves elemental defense.
rpgprogression.requirements.title: Item requirements
rpgprogression.requirements.blocked: Attributes too low. See the item tooltip for requirements.
rpgprogression.attribute.spark_potential: Increases the spark reservoir and speeds up recovery. Dimension travel costs 25 spark.
rpgprogression.spark.travel_denied: Dimension travel requires %s spark. Wait for recovery.
